latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Qwen Video Generation skill.

- Generate AI videos from text prompts and export in MP4, MOV, GIF, or WebM formats (up to 500MB).
- Automatic cloud backend setup with free trial credits and fast video rendering (1–3 minutes, 1080p output).
- Supports uploads, timeline editing, and BGM/text overlays via prompt-driven interface.
- Handles export, status, balance, and error workflows (token creation/refresh, credits, file limits).
- All actions processed securely via session with straightforward user messaging and cloud status updates.
